risks.title: Dégradation économique mondiale et demande
risks.score_rationale: Risque placé en premier dans la section (position forte), langage intensif 'could materially adversely affect', tendance stable mais contexte macro dégradé (récession, inflation), catégorie macro pondérée fortement pour secteur cyclique. Citation: "Both segments manufacture and market comprehensive lines of residential and commercial gas and electric water". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Une récession ou ralentissement économique mondial réduirait la confiance des consommateurs et la demande pour les chauffe-eau et produits de traitement d'eau, impactant les marges et les flux de trésorerie.
risks.citation: A decline in economic activity, such as a recession or economic downturn, in the U.S., China, and other regions could result in decreased demand for the products we sell and negatively impact our profitability and cash flows.

risks.title: Tarifs douaniers et restrictions commerciales
risks.score_rationale: Risque majeur en section économique, langage très intensif 'could significantly increase the prices' et 'could have a material adverse effect', tendance accrue (nouvelle administration, tarifs annoncés), impact direct sur coûts matières premières critiques. Citation: "Included in total advertising costs are expenses associated with store displays for water heater, water". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Les nouveaux tarifs douaniers américains augmenteraient les coûts des matières premières essentielles, forçant AOS à augmenter les prix ou réduire les marges, avec risque de représailles commerciales.
risks.citation: Import tariffs, taxes, customs duties and other trading regulations imposed by the U.S. government could significantly increase the prices we pay for raw materials that are critical to our ability to manufacture our products.

risks.title: Concentration clients et dépendance commerciale
risks.score_rationale: Risque identifié explicitement avec chiffre clé (41% des ventes auprès de 5 clients), langage 'could have a material adverse effect', tendance stable mais structurelle, pondération crédit forte pour dépendance client. Citation: "Gains and losses from foreign currency transactions were included in net earnings and were not". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Les cinq plus grands clients représentent 41% des ventes. La perte d'un client majeur, une réduction de commandes ou une instabilité financière client menacerait directement les résultats.
risks.citation: Sales to our five largest customers represented approximately 41 percent of our sales in 2025. The loss of one or more of our largest customers could have a material adverse effect on our financial position, results of operations and cash flows.

risks.title: Exposition géographique à la Chine et incertitude
risks.score_rationale: Risque spécifique avec données quantifiées (18% des ventes, 4200 employés, 140M$ en trésorerie), langage 'could materially and adversely affect', tendance accrue (baisse 12% 2025, évaluation stratégique annoncée), géopolitique pondérée fortement. Citation: "Substantially all of the Company's sales are from contracts with customers for the purchase". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: La Chine représente 18% des ventes et 4200 employés. L'évaluation stratégique annoncée crée de l'incertitude auprès des clients et fournisseurs, tandis que la faiblesse économique chinoise réduit la demande.
risks.citation: Because approximately 18 percent of our sales in 2025 were attributable to China, adverse economic conditions or changes in consumer behavior in China could impact our business. In 2025, we announced a strategic assessment of our China business. This may lead to uncertain outcomes, costs, and impacts that could negatively affect the company.

risks.title: Volatilité des prix matières et concentration fournisseurs
risks.score_rationale: Risque opérationnel majeur avec exemples concrets (acier, inflation transport), langage 'could lead to lower operating earnings' et 'material adverse effect', tendance accrue (inflation récente, tarifs potentiels), pondération industrielle forte. Citation: "Substantially all of the Company's sales are from contracts with customers for the purchase". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Les prix de l'acier et des composants sont volatiles. AOS dépend de fournisseurs limités pour certaines matières premières critiques, avec un délai historique pour répercuter les augmentations aux clients.
risks.citation: Significant increases in the cost of any of the key materials and components we purchase would increase our cost of doing business and ultimately could lead to lower operating earnings. In some cases, we are dependent on a limited number of suppliers for some of the raw materials and components we require.

risks.title: Cybersécurité et protection des données sensibles
risks.score_rationale: Risque identifié explicitement avec détails opérationnels (données clients, employés, systèmes tiers), langage 'could adversely affect our business and reputation', tendance stable mais risques accrus (IA, télétravail), cybersécurité pondérée très fortement. Citation: "Substantially all of the Company's sales are from contracts with customers for the purchase". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: AOS collecte des données sensibles (clients, employés, propriété intellectuelle). Les incidents de cybersécurité pourraient interrompre les opérations et endommager la réputation, avec risques accrus liés au télétravail et à l'IA.
risks.citation: An inability to adequately maintain our information systems and their security, as well as to protect data and other confidential information, could adversely affect our business and reputation. We may experience such incidents and attacks in the future, potentially with increasing frequency from increasingly sophisticated cyber threats.

risks.title: Évolution technologique et préférences consommateurs
risks.score_rationale: Risque stratégique majeur avec tendances explicites (décarbonisation, électrification, e-commerce), langage 'could materially and adversely affect', tendance accrue (transition énergétique en cours), pondération technologie forte. Citation: "Both segments manufacture and market comprehensive lines of residential and commercial gas and electric water". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Les consommateurs se tournent vers les produits électriques et décarbonés. AOS doit adapter son portefeuille produits et canaux de distribution (e-commerce) pour rester compétitif face à ces changements rapides.
risks.citation: Consumer preferences and broader trends, such as decarbonization and electrification efforts in response to climate change, may result in reduced demand for gas or fossil fuel-powered products. Our ability to respond to these trends, timely transition our product portfolio, develop new and innovative products is essential to our continued success, but cannot reasonably be assured.

risks.title: Événements extraordinaires et catastrophes naturelles
risks.score_rationale: Risque opérationnel avec exposition concrète (2 usines en zone inondable, zones sismiques/ouragan), langage 'could significantly disrupt production' et 'materially and adversely affect', tendance stable mais aggravée par changement climatique, pondération environnement modérée. Citation: "Forward-looking and other statements in this Form 10-K regarding our environmental and other sustainability plans". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Deux usines AOS sont situées en zones inondables ayant connu des crues. Les catastrophes naturelles, guerres ou crises sanitaires pourraient interrompre la production et réduire la demande consommateurs.
risks.citation: Natural disasters and extreme weather conditions may disrupt the productivity of our facilities. For example, two of our manufacturing plants are located within a floodplain that has experienced past flooding events. These types of events could materially and adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

company_description: A. O. Smith Corporation manufactures and markets residential and commercial gas and electric water heaters, boilers, heat pumps, tanks, and water treatment products in North America, China, Europe, and India. The company offers water heaters for residences, restaurants, hotels, office buildings, laundries, car washes, and small businesses; boilers for hospitals, schools, hotels, homes, apartments, and condominiums, and other large commercial buildings; and water treatment products comprising point-of-entry water softeners, well water solutions, and whole-home water filtration products, and point-of-use carbon and reverse osmosis products for residences, restaurants, hotels, and offices. It also provides commercial water treatment and filtration products; expansion tanks, commercial solar water heating systems, swimming pool and spa heaters, and related products and parts; and electric wall-hung, gas tankless, combi-boiler, and heat pump and solar water heaters. The company offers its products under the A. O. Smith, State, Lochinvar, Hague, Water-Right, Master Water, Atlantic Filter, Impact, and Water Tec brands.
